scope: Node report readers and collection session

confirmed_fixes.defect: Filesystem aliases such as macOS /var and /private rejected valid confined evidence paths.
confirmed_fixes.fix: Canonicalize evidence parent before checking confinement.
confirmed_fixes.regression: Evidence paths reject escape and existing files while permitting filesystem aliases.

confirmed_fixes.defect: Conflicting Sonar selectors returned CONNECTOR_FAILURE instead of INVALID_ARGUMENT.
confirmed_fixes.fix: Preserve INVALID_ARGUMENT through the fixed error envelope.
confirmed_fixes.regression: Sonar structured reads preserve selectors and payloads.

verified_boundaries: Actual HTTP-attempt concurrency and one client per session.
Grant and argument denial before network access.
Retry-After on HTTP 200 delays future requests without replay.
Transient 503 retries and forbidden body preservation.
Large streamed artifacts retain exact bytes and SHA-256.
Evidence paths remain confined and existing files remain intact.
Sonar selectors and raw string metrics remain intact.
Collection deadlines abort active and queued reads.
Comparison base/target and common-commit mode follow explicit source selection.
Session endpoint provenance contains no credential values.
limits: Loopback binds require sandbox escalation in this environment.
Real ADO and Sonar services were not contacted.
The focused readers use pooled raw REST through the existing connector configuration and dependencies; generic tools remain SDK-backed.
limitations: Automated checks do not check the complete approved dictionary or grammar rules.
